Class ModifierKeyGamepadButton

Represents a modifier key that is mapped to a gamepad button.

public ModifierKeyGamepadButton(ShapeGamepadButton modifierKey, float joyAxisDeadzone = 0.15, float triggerAxisDeadzone = 0.15, bool reverseModifier = false)

Parameters

modifierKey ShapeGamepadButton

The gamepad button to use as a modifier.

joyAxisDeadzone float

The deadzone threshold for joystick axes, used to ignore minor input noise.

triggerAxisDeadzone float

The deadzone threshold for trigger axes, used to ignore minor input noise.

reverseModifier bool

If set to true, the modifier is considered active when the button is not pressed.

Remarks

The reverseModifier parameter is used to prevent an input from being triggered when a modifier combination is pressed. For example, if you have two inputs: RB + A and A, configuring input A with RB as a reverse modifier ensures that pressing RB + A will not also trigger A.
